patterns: The nationwide FAA ground stop took over the weekend: 87 hits (~17.9M views, about 41% of the window) at a 1.5% like rate. Gunther's 'Sean Duffy laid out EXACTLY what happened' was #1 at ~3.12M, the stranded-traveler '$850 Lyft to Indiana' story got ~2.61M, and 'NBC reporter tried to blame Trump, Duffy shut her down' got ~1.89M at 3.1%

Explainers and human-interest angles beat the raw alerts: 'here's what happened at 3:36 PM' (~3.12M) and the Frankie Lyft story (~2.61M) outran 'FAA issues NATIONWIDE GROUND STOP' (~258k). Every follow-up (root cause, national emergency, 55-year-old hardware, 'not a cyberattack') cleared 150k

Duffy vs the media was the best part of the story for likes: NBC clash ~1.89M (3.1%), 'Dana Bash claimed Trump went MISSING' ~277k (5.2%), Bash 'MASTERCLASS' ~203k (4.7%), 'Duffy TOOK THE BLAME' ~264k (3.7%). Sunday-show clips overall: 16 hits (~1.42M) at 4.6%

Anger at John Thune was again the top like-rate thread: 20 hits (~956k) at 7.7%. Short one-liners won ('never be a closed door secret vote' ~74k at 18.3%, 'which GOP Senators voted to keep SPINELESS John Thune' ~65k at 16.2%)
Warren/Schiff/Hillary lawfare posts did well: 15 hits (~1.32M) at 5.7%. Aaron Reitz 'put Warren ON NOTICE' ~285k (8.5%), 'SCHIFF DARED HIM' ~281k (6.3%), Trump's 'SEDITIOUS SIX' ~166k (11.2%)

rawsalerts' one-line #BREAKING posts hit big off-politics: Canadian cancer patient flees assisted-suicide advice ~2.09M (2.1%), 'GTA VI is now less than 1 shower away' ~632k, Bitly links hijacked ~358k, 'Zoomers one-shotting businesses using AI' ~209k

Iran (15 hits, ~1.22M, 3.6%: Bahrain drone attack ~379k, embassy threat to Navy officers ~159k) and Nvidia/Huang (8 hits, ~588k: Bessent 'new leader from outside' ~289k) kept going. Gunther's 'Hey @grok' questions kept reach with almost no likes: 11 hits (~863k) at 0.3%, led by 'will the UT vs LSU game be played tomorrow?' ~313k
virals_narrative: The outsider AI sweep (last ~48h, ~39 posts) was led by @elonmusk's Grok promos ('Try Grok' ~2.6M, the Grok text-watermarking post ~1.88M, 'Grok can do almost anything' ~1.19M) and @OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra physics story (~655k). @kimmonismus had the best AI-news reach: agents went from 2.5% to 41.3% of Remote Labor Index projects in 13 months (~125k), an Anthropic researcher saying superhuman AI could be ~1.3 years away (~95k), and the Qwen4-Max launch (~45k). The other big story was the WSJ report that the Trump administration plans to name Nvidia and 20+ AI firms 'national champions'. Lots of accounts posted it (@crypto_banter ~11k), but none broke out. That makes it an open lane that fits Patriot Punisher's politics-plus-AI mix.
narrative_synthesis: Friday-to-Monday weekend window, the biggest window on record at ~43.96M views across 529 hits from 535 originals. The FAA nationwide ground stop took over: Gunther's Duffy explainer (~3.12M), the $850 Lyft traveler (~2.61M) and the NBC clash (~1.89M) all went past 1.8M. rawsalerts' Canadian assisted-suicide escape post hit ~2.09M. Like rates were again highest on Thune anger (7.7%), the lawfare fights (5.7%) and Sunday-show Duffy clips (4.6%). Takeaway: on big breaking news, the calm 'here's exactly what happened' explainer and one human story beat the siren alert. Next time a system outage hits, post the timeline and the human cost, not just the headline.
